body_en_plain:
A U G U S T ,   1 9 9 6

The Northern Sam & Spectrum Show
is on 21st September: Methodist
Hall,Wetherby,Yorks. Wetherby is
on the A1 between Leeds and York
and the show is 10.30am to 4pm.
Entry `1.50. Info: 0113 2374800.


May we remind readers, we cannot
answer computer, software, hard-
ware or system queries etc.,
personally by mail.  All of such
queries are answered through the
OUTLETTERS section in OUTLET. We
are sorry to keep harping on
about this but it really needs
to be a permanent reminder!Share
your problems with others! That
way, everyone benefits!

Contributions have improved to a
reasonable extent recently but
remember, we need YOUR support,
and contributions of articles
and programs, especially utility
programs, are now needed more
than ever. Even a short routine
can be like gold dust to another
user! Send 'em in!


Michael Atkins has sent in an
update to his OUTLETTERS data-
base. This is in MASTERFILE +3
format so is only on the +3 ver-
sion of OUTLET as "OUTLET2".
MASTERFILE +3 is in OUTLET 76
(+3 only).

                    Ron & Brian



      OUTLET is produced by

          Chris Oliver
       Ron & Brian Cavers

      34 Saltersgate Drive
   Birstall, Leicester LE4 3FF
.

## Editorial (late)

A U G U S T ,   1 9 9 6

The Northern Sam & Spectrum Show is on 21st September: Methodist Hall,Wetherby,Yorks. Wetherby is on the A1 between Leeds and York and the show is 10.30am to 4pm. Entry `1.50. Info: 0113 2374800.

May we remind readers, we cannot answer computer, software, hard- ware or system queries etc., personally by mail.  All of such queries are answered through the OUTLETTERS section in OUTLET. We are sorry to keep harping on about this but it really needs to be a permanent reminder!Share your problems with others! That way, everyone benefits!

Contributions have improved to a reasonable extent recently but remember, we need YOUR support, and contributions of articles and programs, especially utility programs, are now needed more than ever. Even a short routine can be like gold dust to another user! Send 'em in!

Michael Atkins has sent in an update to his OUTLETTERS data- base. This is in MASTERFILE +3 format so is only on the +3 ver- sion of OUTLET as "OUTLET2". MASTERFILE +3 is in OUTLET 76 (+3 only).

Ron & Brian

OUTLET is produced by

Chris Oliver Ron & Brian Cavers

CHEZRON   SOFTWARE 34 Saltersgate Drive Birstall, Leicester LE4 3FF .
body_ru:
## Editorial (late)

### А В Г У С Т ,   1 9 9 6

The Northern Sam & Spectrum Show пройдет 21 сентября в Methodist Hall, Wetherby, Yorks. Wetherby находится на трассе A1 между Leeds и York, выставка открыта с 10:30 до 16:00. Вход: £1.50. Справки по тел.: 0113 2374800.

Напоминаем читателям: мы не можем отвечать на вопросы о компьютерах, софте, железе, системных проблемах и т.д. лично по почте. Все подобные вопросы разбираются в рубрике OUTLETTERS журнала OUTLET. Нам жаль постоянно твердить об этом, но об этом напоминании забывать нельзя! Делитесь своими проблемами с остальными! Так польза будет для всех!

В последнее время количество присылаемых материалов заметно выросло, но помните: нам нужна ВАША поддержка. Статьи и программы, особенно утилиты, сейчас нужны как никогда. Даже короткая подпрограмма может оказаться на вес золота для другого пользователя! Присылайте их нам!

Michael Atkins прислал обновление для своей базы данных OUTLETTERS. Она выполнена в формате MASTERFILE +3, поэтому представлена только в версии OUTLET для +3 под именем «OUTLET2». Сам MASTERFILE +3 выходил в OUTLET 76 (только для +3).

Ron & Brian
